title: 043-N5 · Shipper silent before allocation cut-off
initial_explanation: We are the coordinator, Iona Quill. The client is Nessa Dray, shipping coordinator at Orris Span. From the case card: freight allocation for DL-043 is paused because the pallet dimensions and weight are missing, and the shipper must provide measured values before the planner allocates a vehicle.
